passages.text: The LORD spoke again to Moses and Aaron, telling them, “Say to the Israelites, ‘Of all the beasts of the earth, these ones you may eat: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
The LORD gave them instructions.
The LORD said, “Speak to the Israelites.
Tell them this message.
You may eat certain animals from all the beasts on the earth.
You may eat any animal that has a split hoof.
The hoof must be completely divided.
The animal must also chew the cud.
You may eat these animals.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ כֹּ֣ל׀ מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: But of those that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, you are not to eat the following: The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses and Aaron.
God gave them instructions for the Israelites.
God said, “You must not eat certain animals.
Some animals chew the cud.
Some animals have a divided hoof.
But some animals have only one of these traits.
You must not eat these animals.
The camel chews the cud.
The camel does not have a divided hoof.
The camel is unclean for you.
You must not eat the camel.”
passages.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ זֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִֽמַּעֲלֵי֙ הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַפַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת־ הַ֠גָּמָל כִּֽי־ מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה ה֗וּא וּפַרְסָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The rock badger, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses and Aaron.
God gave them instructions for the Israelites.
God told them which animals the Israelites may eat.
The rock badger chews the cud.
The rock badger does not have a divided hoof.
The rock badger is unclean for you.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי־ מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ ה֔וּא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
passages.sermon: The rabbit chews the cud.\r\nThe rabbit does not have a divided hoof.\r\nThe rabbit is unclean for you.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי־ מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ הִ֔וא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִ֖וא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
The pig is an animal.
The pig has a split hoof.
The hoof of the pig is completely divided.
The pig does not chew the cud.
The pig is unclean for you.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־ מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֜ה ה֗וּא וְשֹׁסַ֥ע שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה וְה֖וּא גֵּרָ֣ה לֹֽא־ יִגָּ֑ר טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
Some animals are unclean for you.
You must not eat the meat of these unclean animals.
You must not touch the carcasses of these unclean animals.
These animals are unclean for you.
passages.original: מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֣א תִגָּ֑עוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Of all the creatures that live in the water, whether in the seas or in the streams, you may eat anything with fins and scales.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
God said which water creatures are allowed as food.
You may eat creatures that live in water.
This includes creatures in the seas.
This includes creatures in the streams.
You may eat any water creature that has fins.
You may eat any water creature that has scales.
passages.original: אֶת־ זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּמַּ֗יִם בַּיַּמִּ֛ים וּבַנְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: But the following among all the teeming life and creatures in the water are detestable to you: everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
God said some water creatures are unclean.
Any animal in the seas or streams without fins and scales is unclean for you.
This includes all creatures that swarm in the water.
This includes every living thing in the water without fins and scales.
You must consider these animals detestable.
passages.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין־ ל֜וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים֙ וּבַנְּחָלִ֔ים מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַמַּ֔יִם וּמִכֹּ֛ל נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: They shall be an abomination to you; you must not eat their meat, and you must detest their carcasses.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
Some animals in the water do not have fins and scales.
These animals are unclean for you.
You must not eat their meat.
You must detest their dead bodies.
passages.original: וְשֶׁ֖קֶץ יִהְי֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְאֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֖ם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ׃

passages.text: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable to you.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about clean and unclean animals.
God said some animals in the water are not allowed.
Any animal in the water without fins and scales is not allowed.
You must see these animals as detestable.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Additionally, you are to detest the following birds, and they must not be eaten because they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture, the kite, any kind of falcon, any kind of raven, the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk, the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl, the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey, the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
Some birds are detestable.
You must not eat these birds.
They are unclean for you.
The eagle is detestable.
The bearded vulture is detestable.
The black vulture is detestable.
The kite is detestable.
Every kind of falcon is detestable.
Every kind of raven is detestable.
The ostrich is detestable.
The screech owl is detestable.
The gull is detestable.
Every kind of hawk is detestable.
The little owl is detestable.
The cormorant is detestable.
The great owl is detestable.
The white owl is detestable.
The desert owl is detestable.
The osprey is detestable.
The stork is detestable.
Every kind of heron is detestable.
The hoopoe is detestable.
The bat is detestable.
You must not eat any of these birds.
You must consider them unclean.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן־ הָע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הֵ֑ם אֶת־ הַנֶּ֙שֶׁר֙ וְאֶת־ הַפֶּ֔רֶס וְאֵ֖ת הָעָזְנִיָּֽה׃ וְאֶת־ הַ֨דָּאָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הָאַיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃ וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־ הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃ וְאֶת־ הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף׃ וְאֶת־ הַתִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ הַקָּאָ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָרָחָֽם׃ וְאֵת֙ הַחֲסִידָ֔ה הָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְאֶת־ הַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃

passages.text: All flying insects that walk on all fours are detestable to you.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about clean and unclean animals.
God said some animals are not acceptable to eat.
Flying insects that walk on four legs are not acceptable.
You must consider all such insects detestable.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ל שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: However, you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours: those having jointed legs above their feet for hopping on the ground.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel food laws.
God said some animals are clean.
God said some animals are unclean.
God spoke about flying insects.
Some flying insects walk on all fours.
You may eat certain flying insects.
These insects must have jointed legs.
The jointed legs must be above their feet.
These legs are for hopping on the ground.
passages.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר־ לֹא כְרָעַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket, or grasshopper.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel food laws.
God said some flying insects are allowed as food.
You may eat locusts.
You may eat any kind of katydid.
You may eat any kind of cricket.
You may eat any kind of grasshopper.
passages.original: אֶת־ אֵ֤לֶּה מֵהֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת־ הָֽאַרְבֶּ֣ה לְמִינ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ הַסָּלְעָ֖ם לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ הַחַרְגֹּ֣ל לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ הֶחָגָ֖ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable to you.
passages.sermon: All flying insects with four legs are unclean for you.\r\nYou must consider them detestable.
passages.original: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: These creatures will make you unclean. Whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening, and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
Some creatures are unclean for you.
If you touch the carcass of these creatures, you become unclean until evening.
If you pick up the carcass of these creatures, you must wash your clothes.
You will still be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וּלְאֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃ וְכָל־ הַנֹּשֵׂ֖א מִנִּבְלָתָ֑ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Every animal with hooves not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you. Whoever touches any of them will be unclean.
passages.sermon:
Some animals have hooves.
Some hooves are not completely divided.
Some animals do not chew the cud.
These animals are unclean for you.
If you touch any of these animals, you will be unclean.
passages.original: לְֽכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ מַפְרֶ֨סֶת פַּרְסָ֜ה וְשֶׁ֣סַע׀ אֵינֶ֣נָּה שֹׁסַ֗עַת וְגֵרָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: All the four-footed animals that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up a carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening. They are unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
All animals that walk on four feet and have paws are unclean for you.
If you touch the carcass of any of these animals, you will be unclean until evening.
If you pick up the carcass of any of these animals, you must wash your clothes.
You will be unclean until evening.
These animals are unclean for you.
passages.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ כַּפָּ֗יו בְּכָל־ הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל־ אַרְבַּ֔ע טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃ וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה לָכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you: the mole, the mouse, any kind of great lizard, the gecko, the monitor lizard, the common lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean animals.
Some animals that move along the ground are unclean for you.
The mole is unclean for you.
The mouse is unclean for you.
Every kind of great lizard is unclean for you.
The gecko is unclean for you.
The monitor lizard is unclean for you.
The common lizard is unclean for you.
The skink is unclean for you.
The chameleon is unclean for you.
passages.original: וְזֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ הַחֹ֥לֶד וְהָעַכְבָּ֖ר וְהַצָּ֥ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃ וְהָאֲנָקָ֥ה וְהַכֹּ֖חַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹ֖מֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃

passages.text: These animals are unclean for you among all the crawling creatures. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
These animals crawl on the ground.
They are unclean for you.
If you touch any of them after they die, you become unclean.
You will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה הַטְּמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־ הַשָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּהֶ֛ם בְּמֹתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article becomes unclean; any article of wood, clothing, leather, sackcloth, or any implement used for work must be rinsed with water and will remain unclean until evening; then it will be clean.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean things.
Some animals that move along the ground are unclean.
If one of these unclean animals dies, it can make things unclean.
If a dead unclean animal falls on something, that thing becomes unclean.
This rule applies to any wooden object.
It also applies to any clothing.
It applies to anything made of leather.
It applies to anything made of sackcloth.
It applies to any tool or object used for work.
You must rinse that object with water.
It will stay unclean until evening.
After evening, it will be clean.
passages.original: וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּל־ עָלָיו֩ מֵהֶ֨ם׀ בְּמֹתָ֜ם יִטְמָ֗א מִכָּל־ כְּלִי־ עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ־ עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל־ כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם בַּמַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃

passages.text: If any of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean; you must break the pot.
passages.sermon:
A clay pot is a container made from clay.
If a dead unclean crawling creature falls into a clay pot, this makes the pot unclean.
Everything inside the pot becomes unclean.
You must break the clay pot.
passages.original: וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּ֥ל מֵהֶ֖ם אֶל־ תּוֹכ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹכ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְאֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: Any food coming into contact with water from that pot will be unclean, and any drink in such a container will be unclean.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel laws about cleanliness.
\r\nThese laws teach about food and drink.
\r\nIf water touches any food, that food becomes unclean.
\r\nIf a drink is in any container, and it touches something unclean, the drink becomes unclean.
\r\nPeople must not eat or drink what is unclean.
passages.original: מִכָּל־ הָאֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛יו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְכָל־ מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: Anything upon which one of their carcasses falls will be unclean. If it is an oven or cooking pot, it must be smashed; it is unclean and will remain unclean for you.
passages.sermon:
A dead body of an unclean animal can make things unclean.
If a carcass falls on something, that thing becomes unclean.
If a carcass falls on an oven, the oven becomes unclean.
If a carcass falls on a cooking pot, the cooking pot becomes unclean.
You must break the oven or cooking pot if it becomes unclean this way.
These items are unclean for you and will stay unclean.
passages.original: וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּ֨ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֥ם׀ עָלָיו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְכִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ טְמֵאִ֣ים הֵ֑ם וּטְמֵאִ֖ים יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean, but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean.
passages.sermon:
A spring is a source of water.
A cistern is a container that holds water.
A spring or cistern that contains water will stay clean.
If someone touches a carcass in the spring or cistern, that person will become unclean.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה־ מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְנֹגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃

passages.text: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing, the seed is clean; but if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.
passages.sermon: God gave Israel laws about clean and unclean things.\r\nGod said, “If a dead animal falls on any seed that you will plant, the seed stays clean.\r\nIf you put water on the seed, and then a dead animal falls on it, the seed becomes unclean for you.”
passages.original: וְכִ֤י יִפֹּל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔ם עַל־ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ טָה֖וֹר הֽוּא׃ וְכִ֤י יֻתַּן־ מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ זֶ֔רַע וְנָפַ֥ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֖ם עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: If an animal that you may eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about clean and unclean things.
Some animals are allowed for food.
If one of these animals dies by itself, it becomes a carcass.
Anyone who touches the carcass becomes unclean.
That person remains unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכִ֤י יָמוּת֙ מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָ֑ה הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
This law speaks about animals that people may eat if they are alive.
If a person eats from the carcass of such an animal, that person must wash his clothes.
He will be unclean until evening.
If a person picks up the carcass of such an animal, that person must also wash his clothes.
He will be unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְהָֽאֹכֵל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable; it must not be eaten.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commands you to be holy because He is holy.
Some creatures move along the ground.
These creatures are called crawling creatures.
Crawling creatures are detestable.
You must not eat any crawling creature.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃

passages.text: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to His people.
God said, “Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground.”
Some creatures crawl on their bellies.
Some creatures walk on four feet.
Some creatures have more than four feet.
All these creatures move along the ground.
God said, “Do not eat them.”
God said, “These creatures are detestable.”
passages.original: כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל־ גָּח֜וֹן וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל־ מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּם כִּי־ שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵֽם׃

passages.text: Do not defile yourselves by any crawling creature; do not become unclean or defiled by them.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to the people of Israel.
God is holy.
God wants His people to be holy.
Do not make yourselves detestable by any crawling creature.
Do not defile yourselves with them.
Do not become unclean by them.
passages.original: אַל־ תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְלֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְנִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽם׃

passages.text: For I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. You must not defile yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is holy.
You must set yourselves apart for God.
You must be holy.
You must not make yourselves unclean.
Do not defile yourselves with any creature that crawls on the ground.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָ֑נִי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For I am the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD brought you out of the land of Egypt.
The LORD did this so He would be your God.
The LORD is holy.
You must be holy.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: This is the law regarding animals, birds, all living creatures that move in the water, and all creatures that crawl along the ground.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
These laws are about animals.
These laws are about birds.
These laws are about all living creatures that move in the water.
These laws are about all creatures that crawl along the ground.
passages.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וְהָע֔וֹף וְכֹל֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה הָרֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם וּלְכָל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between animals that may be eaten and those that may not.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God brought the Israelites out of Egypt.
God became their God.
God is holy.
God commands the Israelites to be holy.
God gave laws about animals, birds, and all living creatures.
God gave laws about creatures in the water and on the land.
God commands the Israelites to make distinctions.
The Israelites must distinguish between what is unclean and what is clean.
The Israelites must distinguish between animals that may be eaten and animals that may not be eaten.
passages.original: לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבֵ֣ין הַטָּהֹ֑ר וּבֵ֤ין הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַֽנֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּבֵין֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ
